work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CLXXXIV, addressed to the bishop of Nitra (LF30185–30186), deputes him, during the vacancy of Esztergom after Archbishop John's death, to judge all Hungarian ecclesiastical appellate causes belonging to the archiepiscopal forum, commands obedience, derogates contrary statutes and ends with its own 6 November 1832 closing at LF30268. LF30271 is a speck before numeral CLXXXV at LF30274. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF30189–30189; the source closing at LF30265–30268 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die sexta novembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo secundo, pontificatus Nostri anno secundo. Its own provenance note 1 (t Ex Bullario Romano.) is printed at LF30299 inside CLXXXV's first page and is excluded. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
